description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCartServices class which provides various static methods for managing shopping cart operations within an e-commerce system, including loading carts from orders, quotes, or shopping lists, setting options, assigning items to shipping groups, and retrieving cart data.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for operations related to shopping cart management, including loading carts from orders, quotes, shopping lists, and other functionalities for order processing.

methods.name: assignItemShipGroup
methods.description: Assigns a shopping cart item to a different shipping group within the cart.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets shipping options for a specified shipping group within the shopping cart.

methods.name: setPaymentOptions
methods.description: Placeholder method indicating that payment options setting is not yet implemented.

methods.name: setOtherOptions
methods.description: Sets miscellaneous options such as additional emails and purchase order number in the shopping cart.

methods.name: loadCartFromOrder
methods.description: Loads a shopping cart based on an existing order ID, reconstructing the cart with order details, items, attributes, adjustments, and related info.

methods.name: loadCartFromQuote
methods.description: Loads a shopping cart from a quote, converting quote data into a shopping cart structure.

methods.name: loadCartFromShoppingList
methods.description: Creates a shopping cart from a saved shopping list, including items and quantities.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves summarized data about the shopping cart such as totals, taxes, and formatted display values.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItemIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a cart item for a given product ID.

methods.name: resetShipGroupItems
methods.description: Resets the shipping group assignments for all items in the cart.

methods.name: prepareVendorShipGroups
methods.description: Prepares shipping groups for vendor assignments (partial implementation shown).
